origin.note: Program revision 1 adopted the Blender-exported static closure proxy (role barrier) through adopt_geometry on 2026-09-04; extension transactions below are declared here and applied by the harness through applySituationTransaction.

recorded-ego customTimedRoute points are the fire-engine track of the ec-12-fire-engine-gridlock-escape reference run (engine 0.6.0, /tmp reference 2026-09-05) sampled every 0.5 s over [0,14] s, converted xodr-local (x,y) -> scene (x,-y). This is engine-recorded motion used as a recorded source, not a real-world measurement. parked-lead sits at the 12 s sample of the same track, i.e. on the retained spatial path.

policy.semantics: ActionHook returns { targetSpeedMps } for recorded-ego on every planning tick with tS >= 6 using the latest schedule row with fromS <= tS; undefined otherwise. The override replaces the engine-computed target speed (including governor gating), matching hookedIntent in packages/engine/src/sim/engine.ts.

coverageGaps.detail: Condition-trigger coverage comes from one checked-in ttc instance plus six compiled templates. A deliberately threshold-near corpus (parameter draws bracketing each trigger threshold) is not yet pinned; it must be produced with the compiler draw index and frozen before port comparison.

No checked-in scenario-instance carries actors tagged `ambient`; ambient traffic is produced by the Studio `studio.ambientTraffic` extension (SUMO provider), not by the portable compiler. A reference for large generated traffic requires a Studio-materialised instance to be pinned into this set.

No checked-in instance uses `route.kind: timedPolyline` (recorded actor motion) or an external policy authority. The engine tests cover the mechanism synthetically; a real recorded episode must be pinned before the handover boundary is qualified.

Generated static geometry enters through packages/compiler situation.ts geometry patches with verified bindings; no checked-in executable patch exists in the OSS tree (Blender workbench output is external).
